adult-male-01-03:
Create a professional 16-bit pixel-art animation sprite sheet. Use the attached vertical strip solely as the three exact character identity references, one per output row. The OUTPUT is a WIDE RECTANGULAR sheet: exactly THREE rows and FOUR columns, twelve complete rabbit drawings, one figure in each of twelve equally spaced cells. Preserve reference row order and LEFT-facing orientation. All figures are real LIONHEAD RABBITS; their distinctive thick pointed mane around the full neck and cheeks, expressive eye, upright pink-lined rabbit ears, small round tail and the original individual markings are essential. Show four real successive anatomically different drawings for an in-place rabbit HOP (not walking on four legs). Each row depicts that exact individual through all FOUR poses, read left to right: 
COLUMN 1 COIL: compact crouch, pelvis low, widely folded hocks under rump, forepaws lightly down, ears upward. 
COLUMN 2 PUSH: body lengthens and travels LEFT, front paws tucked up off the ground, rear joints UNFOLD, both long hind feet trail behind toward the RIGHT and their toe tips perform last push off the ground; body clearly longer than the crouch.
COLUMN 3 AIR: belly suspended, ALL FOUR feet distinctly tucked underneath with clear air below them; lifted hind paws fold forward, forepaws gathered, ears swept back. True mid-air pose with no paw touching the ground.
COLUMN 4 LAND: front paws REACH down and forward to LEFT and TAKE the weight, nose down, haunches still lifted to the right, hind legs fold forward ready for next crouch. 
Keep each rabbit in its own cell, roughly 70% cell width, same scale through all four phases, consistent head, eye, mane tufts, body marking placement and tail. Do not reduce the rabbit to a puff of fur without paws, do not draw cats/people, and no wings. Each rabbit's silhouettes and paw paths must be drawn separately by its own character designer, not the same inked silhouette with three palette swaps. Keep readable pixel clusters, clean thin warm-brown outline like the input, side/three-quarter profile facing left. Clear transparent margins between all twelve drawings; no lettering, numbers, decoration, panels, separator lines, ground, cast shadows or background. Actual transparent background with clean alpha.
Three full-grown adults, with the longer mature torso, higher ear blades, adult hind feet and developed shaggy neck ruff measured from each reference. Do not use baby head proportions.
Male Lionhead rabbits as shown: broad layered circular mane, full cheek ruff; ground the action in each original male's build.
Top ROW: golden amber tan, honey ruff and pale muzzle, toe caps. Middle ROW: charcoal-black coat and mane, dark brown highlights, light nose and cream toe caps; preserve black silhouette with visible lighter-edged paws. Bottom ROW: silver gray-and-white, silvery cheeks and mane, pale toe caps.
